builds.notes: Supplier release (L, 9 Nov). Light control and clock. The rollback target.

Experimental partition-map diagnostic only (MEE-1079/MEE-1084). Adds authenticated GET&MAP readback; BLE&FW reports D1.4.3. Button gestures, markers and persistent settings are not implemented. Container checks and vendor recovery decoder pass offline; key-check and BLE&OTA parser routes are unchanged in emulation. Physical boot, BLE delivery and rollback to V1.4.2 are untested. Rollback requires this build to boot and accept OTA. Source/review: https://github.com/asaubhagya/meetly/pull/305 (unmerged).

Experimental map-rejection diagnostic (MEE-1079/MEE-1086). Retains all existing memory/header/CRC checks; adds bounded Q/P/B/H/R rejection details for the acquisition app. D1.4.3 boots and replies on the test Clip but rejected its map. D1.4.4 passes offline ARM, container and vendor-decoder checks; physical install/readback/rollback remain untested. Gestures, markers and saved button settings are not implemented. Rollback to stable V1.4.2 requires working boot and OTA. Source/review: https://github.com/asaubhagya/meetly/commit/b4c513d9 (PR #305, unmerged).

Experimental partition diagnostic (MEE-1079/MEE-1087). Physical OTA boot and authenticated 744-byte table read passed on the test Clip; header and CRC independently verified. Rollback to V1.4.2 sent all frames but the Clip has not reconnected and the phone app exited; recovery is unresolved. Do not treat rollback as verified. Button gestures, markers and persistent settings are not implemented. Source: https://github.com/asaubhagya/meetly/commit/9e1b9b872a26f0f4bffee481973cf926d528e38e (PR #307 unmerged).

Loader-limit diagnostic only (MEE-1079/MEE-1087). Adds authenticated fixed GET&LIM read; retains GET&MAP and existing key/OTA routes. Offline ARM, container and supplier recovery checks pass. Physical D1.4.6 installation and rollback remain unverified. Button features and persistent settings are not included. Source: https://github.com/asaubhagya/meetly/commit/dbc1c62d (unmerged).

Experimental button controls: single-press markers, double-press segments, saved light/vibration settings. Includes checked recording close and shutdown/USB/OTA guards. Offline checks pass; physical boot, buttons, persistence, audio import and rollback are not yet verified. Triple-press mute is not implemented. MEE-1079/MEE-1085/MEE-1087. Source: https://github.com/asaubhagya/meetly/commit/f17b48bf (unmerged); requires feature-capable app.
